revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing illustration to edit. Correct ONLY the raised hand and a small adjoining wrist area, on the screen-right side of the girl. That raised arm is her anatomical LEFT arm. Replace the mistaken right-looking palm with an anatomically accurate LEFT hand making a V sign, with the BACK OF THE LEFT HAND facing the viewer and the PALM FACING AWAY toward the wall. Show clearly drawn fingernails on the two extended fingers and dorsal knuckles; NO palm lines. Viewed on screen, the extended INDEX finger is the rightward slanting finger on the RIGHT, the extended MIDDLE finger rises nearly vertically on the LEFT. Ring finger and little finger curl downward to the LEFT side of the middle finger. The thumb belongs to the RIGHT edge beside the index-finger base; it curves naturally around the hidden folded fingers, not across a visible palm. Exactly five fingers, one left hand attached naturally to the existing left wrist and cuff. Keep the hand fully visible, don't hide or remove it, and keep a natural hand size. Preserve EVERYTHING else: same face, closed-eye laughing expression, messy chestnut half-up long hair, hairclip, headphones, teal-and-black hoodie and school outfit, body pose, lowered right hand, camera position, framing, sunset corridor background, window bars, colors, light, and existing rabbit-shaped wall shadow. Do not flip the image. No added text, labels, watermark, or new objects. Single landscape image with identical aspect ratio.
revisions.qa: Raised hand redrawn with dorsal surface and visible fingernails, no palm creases; left-hand reading confirmed by independent final review. Face, clothing, pose and rabbit wall shadow preserved.
